>This reverts commit 97f85882859d696a26a3e9bd41663e7817d4eb51, #1376.
>
>I'd initially thought we would use per-component skills images, so the skills could be maintained alongside the component they helped operate.  However, Mrunal suggested a consolidated, OCP-scoped skills image for easier mounting into agents, and now we have [openshift/agentic-skills][1] (which already includes the placeholder `update-advisor` I'd started over here).
>
>[1] https://github.com/openshift/agentic-skills

## Walkthrough This pull request removes the entire lightspeed directory structure including a Containerfile for building container images, the README documentation for the OpenShift Lightspeed integration, and skill metadata files. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Lightspeed Infrastructure Removal**
`lightspeed/Containerfile.skills`, `lightspeed/README.md`, `lightspeed/skill/update-advisor/SKILL.md`|Removed container build configuration, integration documentation, and skill metadata declarations for the lightspeed service and update-advisor skill.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly indicates this is a revert of a previous commit that added Lightspeed skills, which matches the changeset that removes the Containerfile.skills, README.md, and SKILL.md files. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | PR only removes documentation and configuration files; no test code or Ginkgo patterns are modified. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | PR only removes non-test files and contains no Ginkgo test code to review, making this check not applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This pull request contains no new Ginkgo e2e tests. The PR exclusively removes previously added infrastructure files as part of reverting a prior commit. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR removes Lightspeed skill files, not adding new Ginkgo e2e tests, so SNO compatibility check is not applicable. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR is a revert that removes files; no new deployment manifests, operator code, or controllers are added or modified. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR reverts lightspeed additions by deleting non-executable files (Containerfile and markdown documentation) that do not affect the OTE binary or stdout contract. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR is a revert that removes files from the lightspeed directory without adding any new Ginkgo e2e tests, so the IPv6 and disconnected network compatibility check does not apply. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. |
